equipment.prompt:
Create one game EQUIPMENT SPRITE ATLAS. EXACTLY 4 COLUMNS x 2 ROWS, EIGHT equal square cells, canvas aspect ratio 2:1. Genuine fully transparent background, no backdrop, panels, labels or grid lines. One equipment sprite isolated per cell with 15 percent padding. Crisp dark-outlined CHIBI PIXEL ART, chunky visible square clusters and 2-3 shade materials matching a retro fantasy brawler. No hands or characters. Same silhouette and grip position within each column between rows. All long equipment points straight UP.
Column1 both rows: one small compact REVOLVER pistol pointing straight UP, grip bottom-right, cylinder readable. Row1 gray steel with brown grip; row2 dark steel with cyan inset, same shape.
Column2 both rows: one small FIGHTER KNUCKLE GAUNTLET, a closed fist shaped metal glove overlay, wrist bottom, knuckles top, no forearm or skin. Row1 orange-red metal with charcoal cuff, row2 steel blue metal with charcoal cuff. Do not draw a pair, only one centered gauntlet per cell.
Column3 both rows: full-length slender MAGE STAFF, straight wooden shaft with round orb setting at top, hand grip near middle. Row1 brown wood and gold setting with GREEN orb; row2 dark wood silver setting with VIOLET orb. Equal shaft length and orb size.
Column4 both rows: heavy PRIEST CROSS weapon, broad physical wooden cross with gold/metal reinforcements, long lower shaft, grip on lower shaft. Row1 brown wood, silver bands and gold caps; row2 dark iron-blue wood with silver bands and blue inset. Clearly cross not hammer, four arms, entire weapon in cell.
EIGHT TOTAL EQUIPMENT SPRITES, two color/material variants for each class, no other objects. No glow spill, no shadows, no background checkerboard.

note: Original generation sources preserved with metadata. Deterministic nearest-neighbor normalization; generated animation remains a prototype.
